title: Systēma Perfectī Mediī-Passīvī
subtitle: Perfectum medium-passīvum (λέλυμαι): dēsinentiae adiūnctae DĪRECTĒ themātī reduplicātō, sine vōcālī iūnctīvā — cāsus āthemāticus.
objectives: Coniugāre plēnē perfectum medium-passīvum verbī λύω (λέλυμαι)
Explicāre cūr hoc paradigma sit ‘āthemāticum’: dēsinentiae adiūnctae dīrēctē themātī, sine vōcālī thematicā -ο-/-ε-
Recognōscere hīc — sīcut in aoristō — media et passīva sunt IDENTICA morphologicē (dīversē ab aoristō, ubi dīvergēbant)

content.intro: Perfectum medium-passīvum retinet eundem sēnsum status-praesentis (Gradū IV priōre), applicātum nunc sēnsibus mediō/passīvō (sīcut praesēns mediī-passīvī, Gradū II, sed hīc cum resultātō persistente): λέλυμαι = “solūtus sum [et manet status ille]” vel “mē solvī prō mē ipsō [et manet]”.
content.explanation: Discrīmen morphologicum notābile: perfectum medium-passīvum NŌN adhibet vōcālem thematicam (-ο-/-ε-, ut in praesentī λύομαι) — dēsinentiae adiunguntur DĪRECTĒ themātī reduplicātō: λέλυ-μαι (nōn *λέλυ-ο-μαι). Hoc vocātur patrōnus “āthemāticus” — patrōnus antīquior, quem plēnius vidēbis cum verba in -μι tractantur (posteā).

rules.heading: a) Perfectum Medium-Passīvum: λέλυμαι
rules.body:
PersōnaSingulārisPlūrālis
1ªλέλυμαιλελύμεθα
2ªλέλυσαιλέλυσθε
3ªλέλυταιλέλυνται

Compara cum praesentī mediō-passīvō (λύομαι, Gradū II): dēsinentiae -μαι, -σαι, -ται, -μεθα, -σθε, -νται sunt praesentēs in ambōbus, sed HĪC adiunctae DĪRECTĒ themātī (λελυ-), sine vōcālī thematicā intermediā. Nōtā etiam 2ª sg. λέλυσαι (NŌN contracta, dīversē ā λύῃ praesentis!) — nūlla contractiō occurrit hīc quia nūlla vōcālis thematica intervenit inter thema et σαι.

rules.heading: b) Īnfīnītīvus et Sēnsus
rules.body: Īnfīnītīvus: λελύσθαι (etiam āthemāticus, dēsinentia -σθαι adiūncta dīrēctē). Sēnsus: λέλυμαι potest significāre “solūtus sum” (passīvum, status persistēns) VEL “mē solvī/redēmī prō mē ipsō [et manet]” (medium, status persistēns) — contextus sōlus, sīcut in praesentī, dēcernit inter media/passīva. Discrīmen ab aoristō (Gradū IV priōre, ubi media/passīva DĪVERGĒBANT): hīc, sīcut praesēns, RECONVENIUNT.

rules.heading: c) Cōnspectus: Trēs Systēmata Verbī λύω
rules.body:
SystēmaĀctīvumMediumPassīvum
Praesēnsλύωλύομαι (identica)
Futūrumλύσωλύσομαι(fōrma distīncta, nōn hīc tractāta)
Aoristusἔλυσαἐλυσάμηνἐλύθην
Perfectumλέλυκαλέλυμαι (identica)

Patrōnus: praesēns/perfectum reūniunt media/passīva; aoristus (et futūrum, partim) eōs distinguit. Recordāre hanc tabulam adiuvat immensē organizāre tōtum systēma verbāle Graecum in mente.

examples: ὁ δοῦλος λέλυται. — Servus solūtus est [et manet līber]. (perfectum passīvum, status)
λελύμεθα ἐκ τῶν δεσμῶν. — Solūtī sumus ē vinculīs [et manēmus līberī]. (1ª pl.)
τί λέλυσαι; — Quārē solūtus es? (2ª sg., nōn contracta)
αἱ πύλαι λέλυνται. — Portae solūtae sunt [et manent apertae]. (3ª pl.)
γέγραπται ὁ νόμος. — Scrīptum est lēx [et manet scrīpta, ergō valida]. (γράφω → γέγραπται, ūsus frequēns cum scrīptīs legālibus)

commonMistakes.wrong: Applicāre contractiōnem ad λέλυσαι (2ª sg.), suppōnendō patrōnum identicum praesentis λύῃ.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī perfectum est āthemāticum: nūlla vōcālis thematica interest, ergō nūlla contractiō occurrit — λέλυσαι manet incontracta.
commonMistakes.why: Discrīmen morphologicum notābile inter systēma perfectī (āthemāticum) et praesentis (themāticum) affectat directē fōrmam vīsibilem.

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere perfectum medium et passīvum dīvergunt fōrmā, sīcut in aoristō.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī perfectum RECONVENIT media/passīva in ūnam fōrmam, sīcut praesēns — aoristus est locus ūnicus dīvergentiae.
commonMistakes.why: Patrōnus alternāns (praesēns identicum, aoristus distīnctum, perfectum identicum rūrsus) est facilē cōnfundibilis sine tabulā organizātā clārā.

commonMistakes.wrong: Addere vōcālem thematicam (-ο-/-ε-) ante dēsinentiam perfectī, prōdūcendō *λελύομαι.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī dēsinentiae perfectī mediī-passīvī adiunguntur DĪRECTĒ themātī, sine vōcālī intermediā.
commonMistakes.why: Error hīc orītur ab analogiā incorrēctā cum patrōnō themāticō (praesēns/futūrum/aoristus), quem discipulus iam nōvit melius.

exercises.title: Coniugā Perfectum Medium-Passīvum
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā perfectī mediī-passīvī.

items.prompt: Ἐγὼ ___ ἐκ τῶν δεσμῶν. (1ª sg. perf. mp., “solūtus sum”)
Σὺ τί ___; (2ª sg. perf. mp., “solūtus es”, sine contractiōne)
items.explanation: Perfectum medium-passīvum, 2ª sg., āthemāticum, incontractum: λέλυσαι.

items.prompt: Ὁ δοῦλος ___. (3ª sg. perf. mp., “solūtus est”)
Αἱ πύλαι ___. (3ª pl. perf. mp., “solūtae sunt”)
Adiunguntur dēsinentiae perfectī mediī-passīvī per vōcālem thematicam, sīcut praesēns?
items.explanation: Perfectum medium-passīvum est āthemāticum, dīversē ā praesentī themāticō.

items.prompt: Dīvergunt media et passīva in perfectō, sīcut in aoristō?
options: nōn, reconveniunt in ūnam fōrmam (sīcut praesēns)
items.explanation: Perfectum, sīcut praesēns, nōn distinguit media ā passīvīs morphologicē.

items.prompt: Cūr λέλυσαι nōn est fōrma contracta, dīversē ā λύῃ praesentis?
options: quia nūlla vōcālis thematica interest quae possit contrahī
items.explanation: Sine vōcālī thematicā, nūlla contractiō potest occurrere.

items.prompt: Quae est fōrma perfectī mediī-passīvī 1ª persōnae plūrālis?

items.explanation: Perfectum passīvum indicat status persistēns: lēx scrīpta manet, ergō valida.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Perfectum medium-passīvum est āthemāticum: dēsinentiae adiunguntur dīrēctē themātī.
Media et passīva sunt distīnctae fōrmā in perfectō, sīcut in aoristō.
items.explanation: Falsum: perfectum reconvenit media/passīva, sīcut praesēns.

items.statement: Λέλυσαι est fōrma contracta, analoga λύῃ praesentis.
items.explanation: Falsum: λέλυσαι manet incontracta, quia est āthemātica.

items.statement: In tōtō systemate verbī λύω, praesēns et perfectum reconveniunt media/passīva, ubi aoristus (et partim futūrum) eōs distinguit.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: patrōnus alternāns per tōtum systēma verbāle.

summary: Perfectum medium-passīvum λέλυμαι: λέλυμαι, λέλυσαι, λέλυται // λελύμεθα, λέλυσθε, λέλυνται. Īnfīnītīvus: λελύσθαι.
Systēma āthemāticum: dēsinentiae adiūnctae DĪRECTĒ themātī reduplicātō, sine vōcālī thematicā — ideōque 2ª sg. (λέλυσαι) manet incontracta.
Perfectum, sīcut praesēns, RECONVENIT media/passīva in ūnam fōrmam (dīversē ab aoristō, ubi dīvergunt).
Cōnspectus verbī λύω: praesēns/perfectum unificant media-passīva; aoristus (et futūrum, partim) eōs distinguit — patrōnus organizāns tōtum systēma.
